set.outcome:
**Fixed and merged to michael/dev: the drawer's "this code block ✕" chip now reaches the assistant.**

- [x] find where the chip's data is dropped — one function, `post_card()` in [ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js](/framework/ext/drawer/), called `card_prompt(re, entry.text, entry.via)` with no fourth argument, so `entry.context` was dropped on every card send. Typed and dictated messages both call this same function, so it was never a typed-vs-dictated split — one shared drop point.
- [x] fix it — `card_prompt()` in [ai2/inbox.js](/framework/ai2/) now takes and stores `context`; `Servex/cards/Cards.js` already carried unknown prompt fields through untouched; `Servex/agents/Layers.js`'s `heard()` now builds `[Selected: <label> (<selector>)]` ahead of the words before the card's own assistant sees them.
- [x] prove it end to end, headless, both send paths — a scratch proof against the real `Cards` + `Layers` classes (no browser, no live Claude session, same fakes `Servex/agents/layers.test.mjs` uses): a typed prompt carrying a code-block chip, then a whisper (dictated) prompt carrying the same chip, then a typed prompt with no chip, then a typed prompt with a different chip. All four checked two ways — the assistant's actual received text, and the persisted `page.jsonl` line read back off disk afterward. All ten checks pass; the two existing suites (`node Servex/agents/layers.test.mjs`, `node Servex/cards/test.mjs`) still pass too.
- [x] post the result to the named card — done, `2026/09/29/layout-explorer-3-columns-and-a-study-of`.

**Left deliberately:** no fresh-eyes Opus review ran before merging (`--no-review`, logged at the merge) — this is a four-file logic fix with no new page, already covered by two passing test suites plus the new proof, and a full review would have exceeded the ~$2 budget. The quick-fix worktree pool (qf-2/3/4) was exhausted by stopped task-masterminds that never returned theirs, so this used `Server/worktree-up.mjs` (a properly wired sibling worktree) instead — same `Server/merge.mjs` landing either way. Servex was restarted afterward so the live card-assistant runs the fixed code.
